name: contentful-backup-lambda
description: Backup Lambda: exports Contentful, archives, stages, verifies and promotes to S3
//dependencyNotes: All dependencies are on their LATEST versions. archiver 8 is pure ESM ("type": "module") and no longer exports a callable default — it exports Archiver/ZipArchive/TarArchive/JsonArchive CLASSES. index.js therefore loads it with `const { ZipArchive } = await import('archiver')` INSIDE the async archive function, NOT with require(). require() of it throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on the AWS Lambda nodejs24 runtime, which does not enable require(esm) interop — a local Node with the interop on will happily require it and give a FALSE GREEN, which is how this once reached production and broke a live backup. ZipArchive extends Archiver so every instance method used here (.directory/.pipe/.finalize/.on) is unchanged from 7.x. Guarded by tests/backup-lambda/archiver8-real.unit.test.js, which uses the real package and asserts require() throws.
